name: Volatility-breakdown momentum (short, 5m)
rationale: A rising 5m ATR combined with a strongly NEGATIVE short return is a downside volatility expansion — a breakdown in progress. We short it (direction -1) to ride the continuation as stop cascades and forced deleveraging feed one-sided selling. The other side is the dip-buyer catching a falling knife into thin bids. Edge persists because downside expansions in leveraged crypto are self-reinforcing (liquidation spirals) and asymmetric versus the upside. Distinct from the long ATR-expansion spec by side and by requiring a negative return leg. Disconfirmer: exits when the short return recovers above its exit level (selling exhausted) or the stop (above entry) fires.
